description: Lomb-Scargle power of a gated 4 Hz sinusoid with a mean offset.
name: lombscargle

recipe.fit: floating mean: mean, sine and cosine fitted together per frequency (floating_mean=True); normalize=False
recipe.frequencies: 0.2 Hz to 20 Hz in 0.01 Hz steps, passed to SciPy as angular frequency
recipe.signal: 1.5 + sin(2 pi 4 t + 0.4), kept while (t mod 1) < 0.5
